paragraphs.text: Day 4 · After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Foz do Iguaçu, where you are welcomed and taken to your hotel. The falls, whose name means “big water” in Guarani, are formed by the Iguazu River and consist of some 275 separate falls, surrounded by the rainforest of Iguazu National Park, home to about 2,000 plant species and 400 bird species, including parrots and toucans. The highest, the Devil’s Throat, plunges some 80 metres.

The falls, whose name means “big water” in Guarani, are formed by the Iguazu River and consist of some 275 separate falls, surrounded by the rainforest of Iguazu National Park, home to about 2,000 plant species and 400 bird species, including parrots and toucans.
